changes: Accept only normalized CURRENT_ACCEPTED_DIAGNOSTIC_POINT plus endpoint COMPLETE_VALID, exact DETACH_OBSERVER_DIAGNOSTIC_POINT_V1 and explicit pair=false.
Require complete receipt/adapter/schema reference structures without reading Git or replacing E upstream validity.
Counters and clock bounds uint64; negative/bool/reversed intervals rejected.
Q identity is mandatory64hex. Preserve initial source and actual before-fix witnesses.

scientific_application_conclusions.text: Zero successful detach transitions in this exact covered scope; missing upstream stages remain UNKNOWN.

claim_limits: This report consumes E acceptance; it does not independently accept a run or decode native records.
Head-cycle and way-exposure counts are repeated observations, never unique requests or summed program stall.
Nonexclusive predicates may overlap. Exclusive first-reason bins depend on declared precedence.
Sticky reuse remains set after a merged waiter retires; it differs from having no missing required sectors.
A selected or detached victim and its response/retirement differ from the triggering request and later retry outcome.
No cross-binary speedup, old-S/new-F performance, T-isolated gain, hardware upper bound, or zero-fill.
One new SGEMM diagnostic cannot recover missing historical pressure/eligibility counts for other positive-RO workloads.
Old SGEMM empty certificate and old FWT whole-epoch store exclusion remain separate known upstream explanations; new counters never backfill them.

historical_scope.old_SGEMM: Upstream empty-fallback no RO candidate/transaction under E048 exact condition; not Tag abundance.
historical_scope.old_FWT: Whole-commandlist128B certification excludes every read-containing line due to a store in the same epoch; not Tag abundance.
historical_scope.other_old_positive_RO: Unmeasured dynamic causes remain UNKNOWN; new SGEMM cannot establish their historical counts.
